verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Fly Machines as globally deployable VMs that users configure and scale themselves (e.g. `fly scale`). It shows no managed, single-call AI inference API that removes GPU management or capacity planning. General compute, global regions and a passing mention of a GPU announcement are adjacent building blocks, not the serverless inference capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
